name: Random forest
summary: Averages many decorrelated decision trees trained on bootstrap samples; a robust, low-tuning baseline.
outputs: Predictions or probabilities; out-of-bag error; feature importances.

data_requirements.frequency: Any; no extrapolation beyond training range

assumptions: i.i.d. rows for out-of-bag error to be meaningful
Cannot extrapolate beyond the range of training targets
math_summary: Averages many decorrelated decision trees, each grown on a bootstrap sample with a random subset of features considered at each split; generalisation error depends on tree strength and correlation between trees.
when_to_use: Feature screening on wide tabular data
when_not_to_use: Trending targets that need extrapolation (prices, cumulative series)
When top accuracy matters more than robustness (boosting usually wins on tabular benchmarks, check per case)
pitfalls: Impurity-based importance is biased toward high-cardinality features
Out-of-bag error is optimistic on autocorrelated data

compute.complexity: O(n_trees * n log n * m_try); embarrassingly parallel.
compute.hardware: CPU only, any laptop to cluster.

applicability.use_case: Screening which macro indicators help explain sovereign yield moves
Explaining regional electricity consumption from weather and economic features
